# Compatible and Improved Alternatives

## Same‑Voltage Alternatives
List products that match the input voltage and chipset family.

## Cross‑Voltage Alternatives
Allowed when protocol is compatible.
⚠️ Requires separate power rail or buck converter.

## Feature‑Based Alternatives
Highlight:
- Higher density
- Better color rendering
- Improved efficiency
- COB vs non‑COB differences

## Not Recommended
List products that appear similar but are electrically incompatible.
